$comment: The review app surface that crosses plugin versions. Protocol 0 names any app older than the first shared app and exists only so a newer client can replace it. Later protocol versions may add properties and routes but must keep every one listed here with the same meaning. Governing ADR: docs/ADRs/plantuml-review/shared-review-app.md. Requirements: docs/requirements/single-review-app.md sections 1, 5, and 7.

handedOffAt.description: ISO time the handoff was written; a successor honors a handoff only within 30 seconds of it

signing.bodyHash: SHA-256 hex digest of the raw request or response body, or of the empty string when there is none
signing.request: Header X-Prism-Control: <nonce>.<HMAC-SHA256 hex under the control credential of method, path with query, nonce, and body hash, joined by newlines>; the nonce is 32 hex characters and is refused when seen within 2 minutes
signing.response: Header X-Prism-Proof: HMAC-SHA256 hex under the control credential of the request nonce and the response body hash, joined by a newline; a client discards a response without a valid proof
signing.refusals: A control request without a valid signature, with an Origin header, or with an untrusted Host is answered 403 without a proof

shutdown.effect: With handoff true the app rewrites the discovery file with handoff true and handedOffAt before releasing the lock; a successor reuses port and viewerToken only from such a file written within the last 30 seconds and only on that port.
